request: Remove excessive hill green saturation and reduce fine detail further, preserving the existing major landforms, readable contrast and seamless background transitions.
method: Four separate opaque image edits of calm-v4; hill edits additionally reference accepted blended-v3 and grass.png for color. Only square resize/sRGB/RGB PNG export after generation.

export.composition: Finished painted background and relief in one image; no separate foreground alpha layer.
export.hex_geometry: Full regular hexagons in pointy-top and flat-top orientations; significant forms and complete peaks reviewed visually inside the approved footprint.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, faithful detail cleanup with SHAPE LOCK. Image 1 is the current finished 210px terrain tile TO EDIT. Preserve the same main hill/mountain shapes, number and location of major summits, principal ridge paths, overall outline, occupied area, upright orientation, lighting direction, and natural ground integration. Do NOT redesign the composition, combine peaks, remove main hills, add new hills, change proportions or turn rocky forms into simple cones. Primary edit: reduce the remaining SMALL-SCALE DETAIL much further than image1, by approximately 60 percent. Remove thin branching crease lines, small secondary flutes, little jagged highlight marks, repetitive fine surface strokes, and small tonal chips INSIDE the existing original forms. Replace that detail with broader CONTINUOUS PAINTED SURFACES following the SAME original structure. Keep the major ridges and sharp large light-shadow boundaries CLEAN, CLEAR, STRONGLY READABLE and dimensional. Preserve strong enough dark shadows and coherent lit faces to read at50-80px/hex; no all-over blur, haze, low-contrast wash, pastel treatment or desaturation of the whole relief. Simplify the drawing, not its main shape. Keep attractive painterly cartographic volume, never flat vector, polygonal low-poly, icon or plastic CGI. The peripheral low footslopes alone blend gently into the base; no pale/dark outline, cutout edge, rim or uniform fog halo. One complete square OPAQUE painted tile, full background fills all four corners, no alpha, no hex outline, text, UI, borders or watermark. Keep significant terrain fully inside the source's same orientation-specific regular hex, no chopped peaks.
COLOR CORRECTION IS EQUALLY REQUIRED. Image2 is the OWNER-ACCEPTED COLOR REFERENCE for this same hill composition; image3 is its plain grass base. Image1 is too vivid lime/yellow-green. Return the full hill tile's ground, hill midtones and shadow pigments to the NATURAL SUBDUED OLIVE/KHAKI GREEN PALETTE OF IMAGE2, accurately matching it, while keeping well-defined lit/dark sides. Especially restore the blue component and reduce the excessive yellow-green saturation. Reference background outside the invisible hex averages approximately R153,G176,B85, HSV hue75deg saturation52percent. The too-green current source instead averages R149,G180,B67,saturation63percent. Aim for the former, not the latter. This is NOT a request for pastel washed-out shapes: retain image2's original luminance contrast and warm cream ridge lights. Do not intensify green or make the ground fluorescent/chartreuse. Retain every main original rounded hill mound and location; remove only its small scalloped ripples and fine highlights.
Keep this POINTY-TOP composition exactly upright, same vertical footprint.
